description: This file defines classes for parsing and evaluating formulas within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes the 'FormulaNode' class for creating expression trees and the 'FormulaCalculator' class for executing calculations, handling functions, variables, and date operations, as well as managing configuration related to counters and debug logging.

classes.name: FormulaNode
classes.description: Represents a node in an expression tree for formula computation, holding text, level, parent, children, and evaluated value properties.

classes.name: FormulaCalculator
classes.description: Handles the parsing, evaluation, and management of formulas, including function evaluation, date operations, and global variable counters within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FormulaCalculator with parameters, relation parameters, current module, and user ID, loading configuration and setting debug options.

methods.name: calculateFormula
methods.description: Main method to evaluate a formula string, building a parse tree and calculating its value.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs debug information into a file if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: createTree
methods.description: Creates an expression tree from a formula string for recursive evaluation.

methods.name: findLexicalElementsOnLevel
methods.description: Recursively extracts sub-expressions from the formula and constructs the tree nodes.

methods.name: evaluateTreeLevel
methods.description: Recursively evaluates nodes of the expression tree.

methods.name: evaluateNode
methods.description: Evaluates a node by executing functions or replacing with leaf values; supports various functions including logical, mathematical, string, and date operations.

methods.name: evaluateLeaf
methods.description: Resolves parameter placeholders and global variables within leaf nodes.

methods.name: replaceGlobalVariables
methods.description: Replaces specific global variable placeholders with their current counter values.

methods.name: replaceGlobalVariable
methods.description: Handles specific global variable replacement and counter increment logic.

methods.name: getGlobalVariableConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current counter values from the configuration for specific global variables.

methods.name: setGlobalVariableConfig
methods.description: Updates counter values in the configuration for global variables.

methods.name: formatCounter
methods.description: Formats counter values with a specified number of digits.

methods.name: getDBFormat
methods.description: Converts date strings into database-compatible format, considering user timezone and context.
